say:3:1320343001:1.text: Ludovic! Why did you just leave like that?
say:3:1320343001:1.source_cn: 等一等！柳博米尔，你不能就这样离开。

say:4:1320343002:1.source_cn: 列夫斯基的家人还需要你的帮助！

say:5:1320343003:1.text: I must confess, I do not wish to help him with this.
say:5:1320343003:1.source_cn: 你们看得出来，我不想帮他这个忙。

choice_prompt:6:1320343003.text: I must confess, I do not wish to help him with this.
choice_prompt:6:1320343003.source_cn: 你们看得出来，我不想帮他这个忙。

say:7:1320343005:1.text: Ever since the day I died, I've not been the same Ludovic anymore...
say:7:1320343005:1.source_cn: ……你们知道吗？从柳博米尔死亡的那一天开始，我就不再是...

say:8:1320343006:1.text: Why are you talking about yourself all of a sudden...?
say:8:1320343006:1.source_cn: 诶……？为什么又突然说到你自己身上？

say:9:1320343007:1.text: Because I know better than anyone that a lost life cannot be restored. Even upon return, one is never truly the same.
say:9:1320343007:1.source_cn: 因为我比任何人都清楚。消逝的生命无法补全，即使死而复生...

say:10:1320343008:1.text: When the essence of existence shifts, I remain merely a Graveborn bearing the name "Ludovic".
say:10:1320343008:1.source_cn: 当生命的本质发生了变化……我也只是一个，顶着“柳博米尔...

say:11:1320343009:1.text: Likewise, should another complete the unfinished painting, it would lose its intrinsic artistic merit and singular importance.
say:11:1320343009:1.source_cn: 同样的，未完成的画作如果被他人补完，也会失去原本的艺术...

say:12:1320343010:1.text:
Life and death, wholeness and incompleteness each possess their own inherent meaning, yet they can never be intertwined...
...Nor should they be.
say:12:1320343010:1.source_cn: 生命和死亡、完美和残缺都各有意义，但永远无法缝合在一起...

choice_prompt:13:1320343010.text:
Life and death, wholeness and incompleteness each possess their own inherent meaning, yet they can never be intertwined...
...Nor should they be.
choice_prompt:13:1320343010.source_cn: 生命和死亡、完美和残缺都各有意义，但永远无法缝合在一起。\n……也不应该缝合在一起。

say:14:1320343011:1.text: I'm not entirely clear on the point you are trying to make...
say:14:1320343011:1.male: I'm not entirely clear on the point you are trying to make...
say:14:1320343011:1.female: I'm not entirely clear on the point you are trying to make...

say:15:1320343012:1.text: What Magister is saying is that we only know you as the Graveborn "Ludovic", which means you can lead a life that's different from the human "Ludovic"!
say:15:1320343012:1.source_cn: 梅林的意思是，我们只认识你这位亡灵“柳博米尔”，这说明...
say:15:1320343012:1.male: What Magister is saying is that we only know you as the Graveborn "Ludovic", which means you can lead a life that's different from the human "Ludovic"!
say:15:1320343012:1.female: What Magister is saying is that we only know you as the Graveborn "Ludovic", which means you can lead a life that's different from the human "Ludovic"!

say:16:1320343013:1.text: By completing Levski's painting, you'd be imparting a fresh meaning to it!
say:16:1320343013:1.source_cn: 换到画作上来说……就是补全后的画作会拥有全新的意义！

say:17:1320343014:1.text: Perhaps you're right. But can new meaning truly surpass the old one?
say:17:1320343014:1.source_cn: 或许你说的没错。但新的意义……难道一定会比旧的更好吗？

say:18:1320343015:1.text: I'm afraid I cannot agree with your perspective.
say:18:1320343015:1.source_cn: 请恕我无法认同你们的观点。

choice_prompt:19:1320343015.text: I'm afraid I cannot agree with your perspective.
choice_prompt:19:1320343015.source_cn: 请恕我无法认同你们的观点。

say:20:1320343016:1.text: Exactly... If Levski's family were gone, the painting would lose all its meaning, no matter how long it endures.
say:20:1320343016:1.source_cn: 是啊……如果列夫斯基的家人也都去世，即使那幅画永远流传...

say:22:1320343018:1.text: Your Lordship, Chippy knows you have a big heart! You'll help them, won't you?
say:22:1320343018:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔，你这么善良，肯定会帮助他们的，对吧？

say:24:1320343020:1.text: While money may not quantify the true value of art, it can certainly demonstrate that Levski's life held significance...
say:24:1320343020:1.source_cn: 虽然金钱无法衡量艺术品的价值，但至少可以证明，列夫斯基...

say:25:1320343021:1.text: I shall offer a fair price for that painting, but beyond this, my capacity to assist is limited.
say:25:1320343021:1.source_cn: 我会用高价买下那幅画。至于其它的事，我也无法再做更多了。

say:26:1320343022:1.text: That's wonderful! Chippy knew you'd be so kind!
say:26:1320343022:1.source_cn: 这样也足够了！满满知道，你肯定不会亏待列夫斯基的家人的！

say:27:1320343023:1.text: With enough money, they can finally settle their debts and start anew! Let's hurry back to Evgeny!
say:27:1320343023:1.source_cn: 是呀，只要有了足够的钱，他们就能平安地活下去！我们赶快...

choice:19:0:1.text: But they're out of options now.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 但他们已经走投无路了
choice:19:0:1.male: But they're out of options now.
choice:19:0:1.female: But they're out of options now.

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 只有他们活着，那幅画才有意义

choice:13:0:1.text: You're the only Ludovic I know.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 我认识的柳博米尔只有你一个
choice:13:0:1.male: You're the only Ludovic I know.
choice:13:0:1.female: You're the only Ludovic I know.

choice:13:1:2.text: A finished work will have fresh value.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 补全后的画作会拥有新的意义
choice:13:1:2.male: A finished work will have fresh value.
choice:13:1:2.female: A finished work will have fresh value.

say:29:1320343004:1.text: If you really didn't want to help, you wouldn't still be here.
say:29:1320343004:1.source_cn: 是呀。如果你真的不想帮忙，就不会停在这里了。

choice:6:1:2.text: I can see you're really torn.
choice:6:1:2.male: I can see you're really torn.
choice:6:1:2.female: I can see you're really torn.
